exact_truth_scope: positive-weight supported queries with resolved parameters in the frozen repeatable-read read-only acquisition transaction
non_truth_capture_component_semantics: derived total capture wall minus timed _collect_truth wall; not an independently timed stage
repetition_semantics: one feasibility/cost canary repetition; not a stability estimate
research_question: What wall-clock cost does the frozen Advisor production-exact truth acquisition path incur for the canonical Census13 10,000-query workload?
sensitive_artifact_policy: tracked artifact stores aggregate metadata and digests only; no truth records, snapshot payload, SQL workload body, or DSN

timeout.implementation: separate worker process with READY_FOR_TRUTH/TRUTH_STARTED/TRUTH_FINISHED stage signals
timeout.on_timeout: terminate worker, record timeout, publish no complete artifact

validation_contract.authoritative_comparison: query IDs and cardinality values against canonical Census13 authoritative labels outside the primary timer
validation_contract.query_count_contract: use the frozen workload eligibility contract; do not blindly substitute 10,000 if eligibility differs
validation_contract.success: truth_record_count equals eligible_exact_truth_query_count and compared mismatch count is zero
